title: Close-Grip Pulldown
summary: A pulldown with a narrow, palms-facing grip that gives a long lat stretch and works the biceps more.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: lat pulldown station (seat and thigh pad).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for lats (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.6 for biceps (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.3 for upper back (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly upper back total.

setup.text: Attach a close-grip handle and sit with your thighs locked under the pad.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Return until your arms are straight.

form_cues.cue: Pull the handle to your upper chest
Keep elbows close to your sides
Reach up to a full stretch
Let your shoulders rise at the top to get the full stretch.

mistakes.text: Rocking the torso to start each rep.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: One side at a time, Wider grip, Palms-up or palms-down grip.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Less stable, Lower loading potential.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
